title: Picture-Word Interference Dataset
description: This dataset contains magnetoencephalography (CTF MEG), structural MRI, and behavioural data from 30 healthy young adults performing a picture-word interference task. Participants covertly retrieved picture names and judged whether each name ended in a target sound while hearing distractor words that were phonologically related, semantically related, or unrelated to the picture. The data support event-related analyses time-locked to picture and response onset, as well as source localization using individual anatomical MRIs.
methods_description: Data were collected at the Rotman Research Institute, Baycrest Hospital, Toronto. Each participant completed 3 runs of 120 trials, with equal numbers of trials per picture-word condition. They responded yes or no with right-hand button presses, and reaction time and accuracy were recorded. MEG was recorded with a CTF system and epoched to picture onset and response onset. Each participant also had a structural MRI for source localization.
